scope: alpha.9 durable recovery plus verification-scope hardening and a real loopback OpenAI-compatible reference transport check

verification.realMcp: verified: included read-only package inspector over OS pipes; independent package byte/SHA-256 match; child closed
verification.recovery: verified: child exit left one durable running marker; reload detected it; no auto-resume; explicit reconciliation cleared candidate
verification.localModelTransport: verified: real loopback HTTP/OpenAI-compatible reference process; exact model/receipt identity, cancellation, audit and child cleanup; transport only, not model semantics
verification.externalModels: not tested against a real LM Studio/Ollama/model process
verification.thirdPartyMcp: not tested against a maintained external MCP server

notes: A verified model transport receipt does not become verifiedExternalAction. Semantic model correctness and real model availability remain separate gates.
